subject: Execution runway: onboarding milestones & canary checkpoints
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Brooks <elliot.brooks@tractionworks.com>, Sandi Patel <sandi.patel@tractionworks.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Execution runway: onboarding milestones & canary checkpoints

Hi Elliot / Sandi —

Congrats again on the signature. Attached is the working mutual action plan (MAP) for our post-signature execution runway. I pulled together a concise sprint-based cadence with explicit canary gates so both teams have the same acceptance expectations. High level:– 8-week activation runway broken into three sprints (Provision > Canary > Ramp)– Canary window: 72-hour live test with progressive traffic shifts– Training: two half-day workshops + on-demand recordings– Acceptance criteria: 3 downstream smoke tests green, <200ms median inference latency on the canary pool, no P0 incidents during window

Please review the bullets below and call out anything missing by EOD Wednesday. If that looks good, we'll lock dates and ship invites for the training sessions.

Sprint outline (dates are provisional — see attached MAP PDF for full table):
- Sprint 0 (Provisioning): Aug 9–Aug 15 — infra handover, VPC peering, sample dataset provisioning, access matrix
- Sprint 1 (Canary prep): Aug 16–Aug 29 — model variants baked, pre-warm caches, smoke tests automated
- Sprint 2 (Canary & initial ramp): Aug 30–Sept 12 — live canary (3 days), progressive traffic shift to 25/50/100%, rollback plan rehearsed
- Sprint 3 (Training & handback): Sept 13–Sept 30 — tenant training, runbook handover, performance tuning and cost optimizations

Canary gating (proposed pass/fail):
- Latency SLO: median inference latency <= 200ms over 3h rolling window
- Error rate: model errors / 1M tokens < 1%
- Functional: 95% of key evaluation prompt set must match baseline quality thresholds (see evaluation plan tab)
- Operational: no more than 1 non-critical incident; any P0 => immediate rollback

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf (MAP with milestone table) and training_agenda_q3.xlsx (session outlines).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the Sprint 0 start date (ideally Aug 9)
2) We schedule the two workshop blocks (one for engineers, one for application owners)
3) We finalize the canary KPI threshold values this week and embed them into the MAP

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if you prefer to walk the map together.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
[attachment: mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf (pdf, 320KB)]
[attachment: training_agenda_q3.xlsx (xlsx, 28KB)]

From: Elliot Brooks <elliot.brooks@tractionworks.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Sandi Patel <sandi.patel@tractionworks.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 12:33:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Execution runway: onboarding milestones & canary checkpoints

Mina — thanks, this is very clear and helps a lot. Quick questions from our side before we lock dates: 1) For the canary latency SLO, does the 200ms target assume a mid-size payload (approx 512 tokens) or is it the 95th percentile for short prompts? We want to make sure we're comparing apples-to-apples. 2) On the model evaluation criteria — can you point to the evaluation prompt set you're using? We'll add 8–10 prompts specific to our edge cases (multi-turn, domain-specific entities). 3) For the rollback rehearsal: is the runbook automated via a script or manual steps? We prefer an automated partial-failover script if possible.

We can tentatively confirm Aug 9 for provisioning but would like a short call tomorrow (Tue) at 11:00am ET to align on the above.

Thanks,
Elliot Brooks
Head of Platform Engineering
TractionWorks

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Brooks <elliot.brooks@tractionworks.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 15:21:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Execution runway: onboarding milestones & canary checkpoints

Elliot — quick technical clarifications and proposals from our side: 1) Latency SLO definition: Mina's 200ms is median for 256–512 token end-to-end payload on our dedicated canary pool (NVIDIA A100s with Redwood-optimized kernels). If you expect longer sequences, we should set a separate 95p threshold. 2) Evaluation prompt set: I've uploaded the seed file to the shared Drive link in the MAP (tab: eval_prompts). Please add your 8–10 prompts there; we'll run a baseline comparison and return pass/fail per prompt. 3) Rollback automation: we will provide a one-click failover script that toggles routing and reassigns traffic away from the canary nodes; we still recommend a dry-run during Sprint 1 to validate permissions. 4) Canary orchestration plan (short):
   - Day 0: pre-canary smoke tests and metric baselines
   - Day 1: 25% traffic (6h steady-state) — verify latency & error KPIs
   - Day 2: 50% traffic (6h) — run evaluation prompt pass/fail & business QA
   - Day 3: 100% traffic (24h) — final acceptance window then full cutover

I'll drop a short-run checklist to the Drive folder today (filename: canary_checklist.md). If that's acceptable, we'll update the MAP with our orchestration steps and automation links.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Execution runway: onboarding milestones & canary checkpoints

Thanks all — appreciate the clarity and the proposed automation. Confirming the following from TractionWorks: 1) Sprint 0 provisioning start = Aug 9 is fine. 2) We will upload our 10 evaluation prompts to the Drive folder by EOD Tuesday. 3) We agree to the canary orchestration cadence above; please share the one-click failover script and a short playbook before Aug 16 so we can test in Sprint 1.

Action items for Redwood (summary):
- Share one-click failover script + checklist (Jonas)
- Populate canary_checklist.md in Drive and link to MAP (Jonas)
- Update MAP with final KPI numbers after call (Mina)
- Send calendar invites for: Sprint 0 kickoff (Aug 9 10:00am ET) and Engineer workshop (Aug 18 10:00am ET)

We'll take the training invites and the MAP as the single source of truth for acceptance. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Sandi Patel
VP Product Operations
TractionWorks
